text:
riley_support: Support -> CS handoff for Verdant Health trial. Onboarding blocked — bulk ingest intermittently returning 412/429 and embeddings similarity dropped ~20%. Trial activation fell to 27%. Sales has a check-in in 4 days. Need CS bridge ASAP and a short customer-facing note.

jason_se: Reproduced on their tenant. Cause looks like a recent dedupe+chunking promotion that changed chunk boundaries for long notes; workers are both dropping docs and spiking rate limits. Applied a tenant-scoped throttle and queued a rollback to the previous ingest config. Internal ticket: IR-14055.

nina_csm: I'll own the customer lead and run the bridge. Can someone paste a one-paragraph non-technical blurb I can send now? Scheduling a 30m bridge at 10:30am PT. @arjun_csm_director FYI — if activation remains <30% after 24h, prep renewal mitigation.

arjun_csm_director: Acknowledged. Renewal mitigation ready: (1) 7-day trial extension, (2) pro-rated account credit if impact >24h, (3) prioritized enablement + audit export. Nina, capture customer sentiment and any asks for an embedding export on the bridge.

jason_se: Customer-facing snippet: "We're reverting a recent ingest config change that affected document chunking for your account and have applied a temporary stabilization. Expect improvements within ~30-60 minutes; we'll review live on the bridge and follow up with a remediation timeline."

riley_support: Pushed logs to the thread. Short extracts: `ingest::412 "backpressure" at 2026-09-07T09:12:03Z`, `embed_sim baseline 0.92 -> 0.74 after promo`.

incident_bot: Incident IR-14055 created and escalated to CS. Priority: P2. Bridge scheduled: 2026-09-07T10:30:00-07:00. Eng oncall paged.

nina_csm: Thanks. Owners: immediate customer ping = Nina, bridge + tech RCA = Jason + Riley, post-call remediation & credits = Arjun. I'll send the invite and the short apology note now.

jason_se: Rollback runbook snippet for oncall: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal/api/admin/tenants/rollback -d '{"tenant":"verdant","target":"ingest-stable-v1"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

riley_support: Invite sent to customer, Nina, Arjun, Jason. I'll join early to stream logs and confirm stabilization. Sync 10m prior.

nina_csm: After the bridge I'll update the renewal playbook, attach a short post-call pulse survey, and flag sales for exec outreach if metrics don't recover. :white_check_mark:
